jobs_results.title: Software QA Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Eurovision Services is looking for software QA engineers to join the international software engineering team at our technology hub in Madrid, Spain.

ABOUT THE TECHNOLOGY HUB

The Eurovision Services technology hub in Madrid is responsible for delivering media and broadcast solutions using the most advanced software engineering techniques. As part of the technology team, you will be working with top international engineers specialized in media and see your developments implemented in Tier 1 global sports and news content.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES OF THIS POSITION

In this role as a Software QA Engineer, you will:

• Be responsible for validating our next generation of applications,

• Analyze requirements, design, and write test cases for new features and user stories,

• Execution of both manual and automated test cases,

• Evaluation of the test case results,

• Prepare and execute unit and integration tests,

• Identify and report defects and their root causes using Jira,

•... Design and implement QA automated procedures integrated in the development cycle,

• Work closely with the development teams following our continuous integration workflow,

• You contribute and thrive in a highly agile environment,

• Generate documentation in English,

• Monitor software quality, from code quality to platform reliability.

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

The successful candidate must have some experience working as part of a software development team.

•Hands-on lab experience in automatization tools and software development tools, including version control, build processes, debuggers, QA frameworks (Jira, Xray, Jenkins/Bamboo, Selenium, etc.)

• Used to work under Agile/SCRUM methodologies,

• Scripting language and programming experience (Java, Python, Linux shell, etc.),

• Experience on Linux or Windows running tools, scripts and applications themselves,

• Self-management and ability to work independently with limited supervision,

• You have good verbal and written communication skills in English.

ADDED VALUE

Additional experience in the following areas would be a bonus:
• Knowledge of the Karate Framework
• Experience in OTT/media/broadcast software development projects
• Knowledge of digital video concepts (container formats, codecs, compression schemes, tools, best practices, etc.)
• Experience working collaboratively with geographically distributed and international teams.

Perhaps you are missing some of the listed skills and required experience, but you are

motivated and eager to learn? Then we still want to meet you!

ONCE ON BOARD YOU WILL
• Be part of an outstanding team of software engineers
• Get involved in Tier-1 media projects with impact and visibility
• Occasionally travel to our headquarters in Switzerland for workshops and training
• Enjoy our technology hub, designed to foster a culture of sharing, openness, and creativity.
• Choose your working environment: Apple MacOS or Microsoft Windows
• See your code in cinemascope on a big screen (30-34”) at a comfortable desk

EDUCATION

Bachelor or master’s degree in ICT, Software and/or Telecom.

BENEFITS AND PERKS
• Competitive salary and benefits,
• 28 working days of vacation for all employees,
• A flexible 40-hour working week for work-life balance,
• Hybrid remote work,
• Recognition bonus system,
• Personal incentive plan,
• Private health insurance,
• Company pension fund,
• Ticket restaurant card,
• Public transport card,
• Sponsored gym membership,
• Choose your own laptop backpack,
• Start-up culture but with a consolidated business behind it,
• A multi-cultural environment, made up of a dynamic and international team,
• Enjoy long-term stable employment.

ABOUT EUROVISION SERVICES

With over 60 years of experience in broadcast production and distribution for major sports events, we know that great events don’t happen by accident. As a wholly owned subsidiary of the European Broadcasting Union (EBU), representing public service broadcasters across Europe, we are in a unique position to understand the needs of our customers.

We have one of the largest hybrid satellite and fibre transmission networks of its kind in the world. In addition to our core broadcast services, we are constantly innovating to provide services that allow our customers to enhance their content and adapt it for use on all digital platforms.

This is why we are the first-choice media services provider for event organisers, media organisations and sports federations when they are looking for adaptable, end-to-end solutions to produce, distribute and personalise content for their audiences.

We are Eurovision Services. We deliver excellence in everything we do, to leave our customers free to focus on what matters most to them – creating truly amazing experiences

jobs_results.description:
We are looking for passionate, curious and driven team players who are ready to ignite ideas, push boundaries and drive innovation. At Accenture you’ll work on innovative projects and develop your career, collaborating with the best teams in the world. You'll learn, grow and advance in an innovative culture that thrives on shared success, diverse ways of thinking and enables boundaryless opportunities that can drive your career in new and exciting ways.

About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services at scale in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all off these services.
We combine unmatched experience and specialized capabilities across more than 40 industries-powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. 
With 513,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture brings continuous innovation... to help clients improve their performance and create lasting value across their enterprises.

We are currently looking for QA Engineer in Coruña:
Responsibilities
- Being part of a team, which is in charge of ensuring that our customers are getting the best quality mobile apps;
- Set up test automation frameworks and integrate them to build and release frameworks;
- Prepare and execute manual and automated functional, non-functional and integration tests
- Analyze and determine completeness of the implemented solution;
- Identify, report and track defects and verify defect fixes;
- Perform root cause analysis of issues;
- Help teach and push technical understanding to the rest of the team to help them grow;The following experience and characteristics are relevant to us:Strong Object-Oriented Programming knowledge;
Requirements
- Cypress (or other Javascript web automation tool)
- RestAssured (or other library/framework for API automation testing)
- Espresso / UIAutomator /Roboelectric (Android native Unit/UI automation)
- XCTest / XCUITest (iOS native Unit/UI automation)
What will you get from us
- Indefinite contract with competitive salary.
- Great benefits like health insurance with a 90% premium covered, life insurance and flexible salary.
- Referral bonus.
- English trainings, conferences and certifications.
- Accenture Privilege (many discounts on various products such as travel, banking, IT products and restaurants).
- GymPass.
- Free coffee and fresh fruit in the office.
- You can be part of our group of LGTBY Ally employees.

jobs_results.title: Qa test engineer
jobs_results.description:
HAYS Technology is the Business Consulting Line of the HAYS Group

HAYS is collaborating with the leading provider of micro and optoelectronics services in engineering, procurement, assembly, and test in space and harsh environment markets. They provide a single point of contact for all high reliability electronic component needs, covering testing, engineering, procurement, storage, quality control, certification and consultancy.
They have played and continue to play an important role in the field of component engineering, procurement and testing in most European space projects, as well as in a large number of non-European projects (India, Japan, China, Russia, Israel, Brazil, Argentina, among others).
In addition, for space and other demanding sectors of activity such as aeronautics, defence and security, they have been involved in numerous product conformity projects.

We are looking for a QA Test Engineer, to expand their team.

What would your duties be?

- Execution of test plans... for the correct verification of compliance with functional requirements at end-user level (software and hardware).
- Joint analysis with the client of the results obtained.
- Recording of all incidents and definition of new developments to be implemented to achieve product compliance.
- Improve test plans and test cases. Execute and automate test cases.
- Understand test requirements and test characteristics. Work closely with product teams, developers and other engineers.
- Design and build end-to-end test cases.
- Ensure that delivered software meets the required quality levels.
- Work with different stakeholders and other developers to define test strategy, as well as implement continuous integration and test automation approaches.

Which are the requirements for this position?

- Experience with bug reporting tools (JIRA, Redmine, GIT).
- Experience with test management tools (TestRail, ALM, TestLink).
- Profile with more than 2 years of experience as QA in functional testing.
- Fluent level of English is mandatory.

What we offer?

- Work modality: On-site.
- Location: Madrid.
- Project duration: 3 months with the possibility of extension.
- We preferably need Freelancers.
- Flexible schedule.

We are waiting for profiles like yours, passionate about technology and who want to face a new challenge. If this is your case, sign up for the offer so we can tell you more

jobs_results.title: QA and Test Specialist
jobs_results.description:
Just Landed is creating the online destination for the 200 million plus people in the world who are moving country or live abroad.

We’re looking for brilliant people who want to grow with our project and build a true market leader. Your work will get in front of 2 million visitors a month. We have flat hierarchy in the team and the atmosphere is start-up, not "big company". Development is all based in our office in Madrid, which has a garden with a barbecue in it ;)
Who we are looking for?

We're looking to hire a software tester to help manual, automatic, and usability testing. We are looking for smart testers, junior/senior experienced. We need those testers who will guarantee the quality of development team software deliverables along with product usability. You will be part of the development team and will close together with developers on defining test cases for every feature those will be working on. A great tester gives programmers immediate feedback on what they did right and... and what they did wrong.
What do we expect from our testers?
• Intelligence and curiosity
• Top testing skills. You can write and run test scripts, set up test environments platform testing, write test plans, create and execute test cases.
• You have a high standard for web usability and you are really willing to share it with us.
• A crushing ability to make just about anything break.
• A scientific approach to everything and unusual attention to detail.
What are we working with?

Ruby / Rails, Git, Cucumber, Rspec, Selenium, Hudson, Redmine, Amazon EC2 and S3, and a bunch of other stuff.
Which languages do we speak in the office?

Twelve nationalities in the office means the common language is English. You should be able to write and speak to a level where you can communicate clearly, but fluency is not a requirement. Knowledge of Spanish is not a requirement.
Currently we can only consider candidates who can legally work in the EU

If you are looking for a challenging environment where you can develop professionally and build technology which people use and enjoy, we want to talk to you.

Interested? email us with the following:
• your CV or link to profile
• links to recent projects with a clear description of what you did for each one
• links to your online profiles on GitHub, Stack Overflow, Twitter, LinkedIn, etc...
• a letter explaining what your professional goals are and why you will be a good match for our company

jobs_results.title: QA Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a QA Engineer (flexible working time and partial remote work possible) to join our growing team in Madrid, Spain.

Join our team to work on our cloud photogrammetry software suite. Angular, Openlayers, ThreeJS, Python, AWS, and various libraries constitute the technical stack we use to turn images into geolocalized 2D and 3D scenes using our processing engine. Our applications help our customers to create digital twins of their surrounding environment to analyze it. We are an agile team where code reviews, pair programming, and continuous deployment to production are part of the culture.

You will play a central role in the quality management, delivery, and scaling of our applications. From the initial definition to acceptance, release, deployment, and support, your key contribution will help the team push the web limit.

If you are passionate about maps, 3D, and managing quality; enjoy learning and sharing good practices; are at ease working autonomously; and... communicate good vibes alongside bug reports, we need to talk.

Responsibilities
• Develop manual or automated test plans meeting product requirements;
• Estimate, prioritize, plan, and coordinate your QA activities;
• Run both manual and automated tests;
• Report the quality of the product systems qualitatively and quantitatively via discovered bugs and test results;
• Maintain existing automated tests with team colleagues;
• Manage Test Data;
• Work with the other members of the cross-functional team;
• Answer internal queries about the Cloud capabilities, limitations, interfaces, general knowledge, etc;
• Stay up-to-date with the best test tools and methodologies.
• Essential:
• 2+ years of programming/scripting experience in Python, Javascript, or similar;
• 2+ years of web or mobile software testing work experience or similar roles;
• Experience in testing cloud or mobile software;
• Strong organizational skills to work autonomously;
• Excellent English communication skills (written, spoken, reading & listening);
• Desirable:
• Building Infrastructure Modeling (BIM) industry knowledge/experience
• GIS and/or Photogrammetry knowledge/experience
• Software engineering experience
• Flexible working hours
• Remote and office work in an international environment
• Private Health insurance with Mapfre
• Access to Gympass
• Mental, Legal and Financial assistance program
• Flexible benefits with Sodexo (childcare, transportation, restaurants)
• 25 days of paid vacation
• Budget for personal development and training
• Company Social Events like our yearly fondue in Switzerland
• Discounts for different activities and services with WeWork membership.

Working environment

Pix4D is a unique, fun, and intellectually stimulating company where you can grow and excel in your field. Our environment is authentic and multicultural, a place where we respect and learn from each other in the pursuit of being the best at what we do. Get more information here.

Recruitment

Pix4D promotes diversity and offers opportunities across all levels and career paths in all of its offices regardless of gender, race, or religion. We use standardized and structured interviews to ensure all candidates are treated equally and avoid any discrimination.

Company
When you work at Pix4D, you empower professionals worldwide to digitize reality through survey-grade georeferenced 2D maps and 3D models. These outputs can be measured, analyzed, and shared, all based on data from images taken by plane, drone, or mobile phone.

We build solutions that take advantage of technology including reality capture, computer vision, digital twins, and machine learning to help solve our customers' most complex challenges.

Founded in 2011, Pix4D has its headquarters in Lausanne, Switzerland and commercial and R&D offices in Denver, Berlin, Bucharest, Tokyo and Madrid.
• #LI-VC1
• #LI-Hybrid

Founded in 2011, Pix4D has its headquarters in Lausanne, Switzerland and commercial and R&D offices in Denver, Berlin, Bucharest, Tokyo and Madrid.

Why YOU want this position
Enverus has expanded its solutions in Power & Renewables with the addition of RatedPower. A high growth start up, RatedPower’s technology expands our portfolio of solutions in solar with its cloud-based software that automates and optimizes the feasibility study, analysis, design and engineering of solar power plants, and our geographical coverage internationally.

Enverus is the leading energy SaaS company delivering highly technical insights and predictive/prescriptive analytics that empower customers to make decisions that increase profit. Enverus’ innovative technologies drive production and investment strategies, enable best practices for energy and commodity trading and risk management, and reduce costs through automated processes across critical business functions. Enverus is a strategic partner to more than 6,000 customers in 50 countries.

We are currently seeking a QA Engineer to join our RatedPower team working in Madrid or remote. This role... offers the opportunity to join a rapidly growing company delivering industry-leading solutions. Be a part of the energy transition and join our growing team, creating intelligent connections across the energy value chain with a strategic focus on growing our offerings in Power & Renewables.
What you’ll do:
• Assist and collaborate with Product Management, Design, and Engineering to define test plans, test cases, and acceptance criteria.
• Work closely within the Front and Backend Development Teams.
• Help test the application through both manual and automated means by following the testing pyramid.
• Contribute to improving and applying QA best practices, provide specific guidance to developers.
• Help maintain documentation.
• Report and assist in triage of issues related to the product.
• Understand the business and use this understanding to influence their task prioritisation.
What you should have:
• 2+ years of relevant experience.
• Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle.
• Experience of working in an agile software development environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Excellent verbal and written communication.
• Familiar with any of the following programming languages: Java, Javascript.
• Experience in both manual and automated testing: unit, integration, end-to-end.
• Experience in automation tools such as Cypress.
• Comfortable with version control systems.
Valuable skills:
• Experience of software development.
• Continuous integration and issue tracking tools such JIRA.
• Knowledge of Civil or Electrical Engineering.

What we offer:
• Work on a unique product where you can see the result of your work materialize in every new release.
• You choose: position fully remote (based in Spain) or hybrid working model (able to combine working from home and from our office in Madrid city center).
• Career development according to your aspirations and interests. We support our employees with continuous training.
• Health insurance, meals/transportation and other benefits.
• The opportunity to challenge in a high-performing organization and leave each day knowing you have made an impact

jobs_results.title: Remote Automation QA Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Company
Hellotickets is building the largest global marketplace for travel experiences, from a Broadway musical show to a helicopter tour in Rio de Janeiro. Although they are a young startup, their platform is already presented in 15 countries — all with their local currencies and payment methods. The company is financially backed by key players in the entertainment and travel industry, like LCD SoundSystem’s James Murphy, Sony Music’s Managing Director and the Founder of TripAdvisor.
Description
At the moment the company is looking for a QA Engineer to join the team. The position is fully remote and requires no relocation to Madrid.

Tasks:
• Testing of API and UI
• Bug reports creation
• Development of test documentation

Must-have:
• Minimum of 3+ years experience in test automation like integration tests, end-to-end tests
• Knowledge of TypeScript, JavaScript, Playwright
• Experience in writing API, DB, UI tests using framework above
• Good English (B2+) and Russian (C1+)
•... Timezones: UTC-1 - UTC+6.

Benefits:
• Full-time, remote job
• 4 days working week (Monday - Thursday, Friday day off)
• Paid vacation (20 days) and sick leaves
• Flexible working schedule
• Friendly professional staff and warm atmosphere

Interview process:
• Intro call with Toughbyte
• Interview with HR
• Technical interview
• Final interview with The Head of Product
